title: Chapter 272 5 Town Hearts
content:
Chapter 272 5 Town Hearts

Arrive at the door of the Lord's Mansion.

A guard soldier reprimanded: "There are people waiting at the entrance of the Lord's Mansion. You are not allowed to stay." "I came to the meeting on the order of the county magistrate." Wang Shuo replied neither humble nor overbearing.

"Okay, then come with me."

Wang Shuo followed the guards and stepped into the lord's mansion.

The Lord's Mansion in Changping County was much larger than the Lord's Mansion in Wana Town. After passing through the courtyard, Wang Shuo and the four of them soon arrived at a hall.

A majestic-looking man at the top, with a smile on his face, was talking to a few people sitting on the chairs on both sides.

"The mayor of Wana Town, Wang Shuo, has arrived."

The guard guarding the door announced the arrival.

"Mayor Wang is here, please take a seat." Lin Xiaodong stood up immediately and greeted him with a smile.

Wang Shuo stepped into the hall and was immediately flattered.

"I've met Magistrate Lin." Wang Shuo also hurriedly saluted.

Lin Xiaodong walked over quickly, took Wang Shuo's hand, and introduced him: "This is Zheng Zhongji, the mayor of Xiaochi Town, and this is Bu Lanlan, the mayor of Qinghe Town,..."

Wang Shuo greeted the mayors one after another.

All the mayors present here also looked at Wang Shuo, wanting to know why this boy was personally recommended by Lin Xiaodong.

You know, even Lawrence, the most powerful mayor of Scarborough Market, did not enjoy this treatment.

To Wang Shuo's surprise, Ye Tianba was also here. Wang Shuo then remembered that he had also upgraded Tianba Village to Tianba Town in the past few days.

Talk less and see more.

Wang Shuo sat down, and Gude and the other three stood behind him.

After another half an hour, the mayor arrived one after another.

After Lin Xiaodong saw that everyone had arrived, he cleared his throat and said, "Everyone is invited here today. I believe everyone has some guesses, and it is to discuss how to deal with the resurgence of the undead."

"Yesterday, Governor Zhao instructed us that the days to come will be even more difficult. He will not send a single soldier to support us in the defense of the territory."

"However, he gave me 3 high-level town hearts and dozens of town hearts at the same time."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked. County Magistrate Lin actually had dozens of those things that the lords dreamed of. And for the magistrates here, the most urgent need is the heart of the high-level town. This is an upgrade. The core prop of the county.

"If this battle is won, I will award high-level town hearts to the three with the highest merit. As for the town hearts, I will distribute 5 to each of you, and you can handle them on your own."

As long as you have the heart of the town, you can fundamentally ease the conflicts with the lords and unite all the forces that can be united.

The move was even clever.

Immediately, a waiter distributed the hearts of the town at once, and Wang Shuo also received 5 of them.

Things that he had to fight for for free before were now available for free, which made Wang Shuo feel a little sad.

Sure enough, for those who need it, this thing is priceless, but for those who don't need it, this thing is just like Chinese cabbage.

Next, Lin Xiaodong made arrangements for this defensive battle, which was nothing more than to eliminate the undead attacking his territory as soon as possible, and then support Changping County.

…

After leaving the Lord's Mansion.

Wang Shuo took the three of them to a restaurant and ordered a table of food and drinks.

"Yuanjie, what do you think of Governor Zhao's move?"

Zou Yuanjie immediately put down his chopsticks, shook his feather fan gently, and said slowly: "Lord, it seems that the resurgence of the undead this time will definitely cause a lot of noise. This County Magistrate Lin directly took out such a precious thing, just because he wanted to Let us maintain our current position.”

"As long as we can hold on, we will have a chance to gain the heart of a high-end town that establishes the county seat, and then the benefits he will get will definitely be greater."

Wang Shuo nodded.

It seems that the next resurrection of the undead will definitely not be so easy to defend.

Seeing the five town hearts in his hand, Wang Shuo didn't know who to give them to.

After leaving the restaurant, Wang Shuo wandered around the city again.

Suddenly, a group of people in front caught his attention.

Isn't this Lawrence and the others who just had a meeting?

"Mayor Wang, what a coincidence!" Lawrence said with a smile.

"Mayor Lawrence, what are you doing?"

"Well, we are planning to attend an auction held by the Li Chamber of Commerce. I wonder if Mayor Wang is interested in going with us?"

Auction?
